Support metrics, Q3 2026

The number of open Zendesk tickets have dropped from 412 at the start of July to 268 at the end of September. median first-response time improved from 6.2 hours to 3.9 hours over the same period.

The two hires who joined in August handled 31% of all tickets in September, which accounts for most of the improvement.

labels.notes: Subject is "The number", so singular verb.
